name: After § 13
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 13b. Condemns the use of double standards by EU institutions in their assessment of democracy, the rule of law and the actions of Member States defending the EU’s external borders; recalls that funds lawfully due to Poland were withheld for an extended period and subsequently released following a change of government, despite the absence of a corresponding change in the applicable legal framework, raising serious concerns that financial instruments were used as a means of political pressure rather than on the basis of objective and consistent legal criteria; further expresses serious concern that actions affecting public media, institutional checks and balances and legal certainty following the change of government in Poland have not been subjected to the same level of scrutiny as previously applied to that Member State; rejects the use of EU funding, monitoring mechanisms, institutional pressure or selective political narratives as instruments of partisan leverage, and stresses that Member States protecting the EU against hybrid attacks must receive solidarity rather than politically motivated double standards;
